sources.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos PC Trilogy Archive
sources.description: الملفات الأصلية والرسومات المفرغة من ثلاثية Power of Chaos (Yugi the Destiny, Kaiba the Revenge, Joey the Passion).

verification_policy.local_asset_integrity: All 1115 BMP files preserved with exact original naming and dimensions (200x290 24bpp).
verification_policy.unverified_data_handling: Clearly flagged as pending_review without hallucinating fake statistics or arbitrary values.
verification_policy.offline_first: All data and images are bundled locally for 100% offline functionality without third-party CDN dependency.
